title: Malicious code in cantarel (npm)
description: The npm package 'cantarel' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise may lead to full control by an outside entity, risking exposure of all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package is advised, along with rotation of all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised machine. However, removal of the package alone may not fully eradicate the malicious presence.
